change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, map each block's full local ordinal range to adjacent four-row groups spaced by 4*blockCount. Distribute partial-stripe lanes independently across blocks so per-block row counts differ by at most one. Reuse the grouped ordinal-to-row helper for input, prefetch, and output; arithmetic and tile processing are unchanged.
